summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Avos Global Equities ETF (AVOS) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund is an actively managed fund that invests in equity securities of various market capitalization. The fund employs a multi-step process to ensure geographic and sector diversification. AVOS was launched on Mar 5, 2026 and is issued by Avos.

holdings.infoBox: AVOS is an equity ETF with a total of 261 individual holdings. The top holdings are Vanguard FTSE Developed Markets ETF stock at 17.95%, Vanguard FTSE Emerging Markets ETF at 13.17%, Apple at 2.14%, Alphabet at 1.94%, and iShares MSCI China ETF at 1.84%.
